## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (90%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Invasive · Careful review
Invasive carcinoma (9% probability) remains inside the 90% conformal set, triggering Tier 2 priority [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 90%, Invasive 9% | Favors InSitu; low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% coverage) | Cannot exclude Invasive at 90% |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 100% OOD [F6] | Atypical OOD, but reliable input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 4/5 InSitu (80%) [F5] | Mostly InSitu; nearest is Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 0, 2, 8) · context · Pulls against invasive (-0.95); 8/20 AI spot-check [F2] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 4, 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · Top pro-invasive score (+0.94), but 0/20 spot-check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 1, 9) · ↓ invasive · Pulls against invasive (-0.75); 12/20 AI spot-check [F4] · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 1, 5, 8) · ↑ invasive · Pushes toward invasive (+0.36), but 3/20 spot-check · Unreliable
- **Tumor cellularity and atypia** (regions 1, 5, 8) · context · 72% tumor cells (97th percentile) [F7]; 90th percentile nuclear variation [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top-3 risk regions drops P(invasive) beyond random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion CI -0.009–0.006 includes 0); leans on Unreliable mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Nearest neighbor BACH_0134 (83% similarity) is Invasive, and high-risk regions 5 (55%), 1 (38%), 8 (21%) harbor invasion.
- HoVer-Net measured 0% immune [F11] and 0% dead cells in regions 1, 5, 8, contradicting TIL and necrosis concepts.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 1, 8**: Highest risk (55%, 38%, 21%) and tumor density (4097/mm² [F8]); exclude stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 0, 1, 9**: Check duct borders; consider drafted p63/calponin orders for myoepithelium and ER for DCIS.
3. **Regions 4, 8, 9**: Verify mitoses and nuclear pleomorphism [F10] directly; mitosis concept is Unreliable (0/20).

found: The CONCH–MUSK row names InSitu, but agreement.conch_musk_same_top only says the two models agree with each other; the JSON does not say which class they chose.
